Activity Description: Classify the customer billing system as high impact based on harm to customers
A senior official signs a decision allowing the billing system to go live
Choose a baseline control set based on impact level and tailor it to system risks
Track the system, its control state, and new threats on an ongoing basis
Define risk appetite, assign risk roles, and identify common controls before system work
An independent assessor tests whether deployed controls are working as intended
Deploy the selected controls into the billing system environment
Record the system description, boundary, and data types in the system inventory
Document the control implementation details in the system security plan
Produce the assessment report listing control weaknesses found during testing
Establish the organization wide risk management strategy
Review residual risk and accept it before granting an authorization to operate
Re-run the categorization after a new data type is added to the system
